tribunal.name: Le tribunal
tribunal.alt: The old courtroom of the village Palais de justice on a family mock-trial open day, dark wood paneling and a green-and-cream tiled floor under brass lamps. A smiling white-haired judge sits at the raised bench at the back. In the jury box at the back left a lady juror in a feathered hat wags her finger at a startled lawyer in a white wig. On a bench a cartoon criminal in a striped shirt and eye mask sips tea from a tin mug, and in the left foreground a big hairy brute looks sheepish over a china teapot and a smashed cup. In the middle a grinning jailbird signs a paper with an enormous feather quill pen. On the right a mafioso in a pinstripe suit poses with a tennis racket, a stalk of celery in a black mask and striped shirt sits in the dock, and a masked burglar tiptoes off with a giant wedge of brie. A small antique revolver lies on a turning stand in a glass case at the right, and three spectators on the upper balcony peer through opera glasses. A tall shelf of leather-bound law books stands under the balcony at the right. Door: plain gray on the left wall, out to Place de la Mairie.
